svg.aria-label: Which services call which, by URL
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: each arrow is a URL in the caller's values file; every target serves on :8080
namespace ticketdrop: the short Service name resolves
payments, fulfillment and notifications are called by nobody: their work arrives on their
queues. Postgres and goaws are reached in namespace data by their full names.
